messages.subject: Hierarchical spatial modeling workshop, Switzerland, June 2024
parts:
Hi all,

From 24-27 June 2024, Marc Kéry, Gesa von Hirschheydt, and I will teach a 4-day workshop at the Swiss Ornithological Institute in Sempach, Switzerland on "Hierarchical spatial modelling for applied population and community ecology". In this workshop, we will present highly scalable approaches for hierarchical Bayesian spatial modelling of species distributions and abundance with a focus on practical implementation of the models using the spOccupancy and spAbundance R packages.

Please see the attached flyer for more information about the course and for how to apply.

Kind regards,

Jeff Doser
